{{Recipe summary
| Category = Seafood recipes
| Servings = 4
}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Seafood|Seafood]] | [[Cookbook:Mussel|Mussel]]

==Ingredients==
*450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]]) [[Cookbook:Mussel|mussels]], rinsed and scrubbed
*225 g (8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], cooked and [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
*175 g (6 oz) [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], cooked and diced
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
*3 tbsp wine [[Cookbook:Vinegar|vinegar]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]

==Procedure==
#Place the mussels in a large pot or [[Cookbook:Steamer|steamer]] with about 1–2 inches of [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiling]] liquid (e.g. water, [[Cookbook:Wine|wine]], or seasoned [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]])
#Cover and [[Cookbook:Steaming|steam]] over high heat for approximately 5 minutes or until the shells open 
#Discard any mussels that do not open.
#Remove mussel meal from the shells
#Mix together the mussels, potatoes, and carrots and arrange on a suitable serving dish.
#Thoroughly blend the oil, vinegar, and seasoning and pour over the salad.
#Chill well before serving.
